name: gizza-ai/csv-window-functions
summary: Add SQL window-function columns (running total, moving average, lag/lead, rank) to CSV rows.

tool.description: Compute SQL-style window functions over CSV rows without collapsing them, appending one result column to every row. Supports running_total (cumulative sum), moving_average (trailing mean), lag and lead, rank, dense_rank, and row_number. Evaluate within partitions (partition_by) and an optional in-partition sort (order_by), choose the value column by header name or 1-based index, set the moving-average window or lag/lead offset, name the output column, rank ascending or descending, and pick comma/tab/semicolon/pipe delimiters. Returns CSV text grouped by partition. Requires a header row.

column.description: Value column (header name or 1-based index) the function reads. Required for every function except row_number.

data.description: Input CSV text. The first row must be a header row; every input row is preserved and one result column is appended.

delimiter.description: CSV field delimiter for both input and output: comma (default), tab, semicolon, or pipe.

descending.description: Reverse the order_by sort, and rank largest value first. Default false.

function.description: Window function to apply: running_total (cumulative sum), moving_average (trailing mean over `window` rows), lag/lead (value `offset` rows before/after), rank/dense_rank (position by value, ties share a rank), or row_number (1-based position). Default running_total.

has_header.description: Treat the first CSV row as a header row. This tool requires a header row, so leave this on. Default true.

offset.description: lag/lead only: how many rows before (lag) or after (lead) the current row to read. Default 1.

order_by.description: Comma-separated columns to sort rows by within each partition before computing. Empty means input order.

output_column.description: Name of the appended result column. Empty picks a sensible default such as running_total_<column> or rank.

partition_by.description: Comma-separated columns to partition by. Each distinct combination is an independent window. Empty means one window over all rows.

window.description: moving_average only: number of trailing rows in the frame, including the current row. Default 3.
